headlines.title: Republican senators vote to hold Dr. Fauci in contempt of Congress
headlines.description: Republicans on the Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee have voted to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress after he invoked his Fifth Amendment right to not answer their questions during a hearing on the Covid pandemic.

headlines.title: Trump Reacts to Abdul El-Sayed's Win in Michigan Primary
headlines.description: President Donald Trump and top Republicans unleashed a series of attacks on progressive Abdul El-Sayed, the new Democratic nominee in the battleground state of Michigan. “When I watch Abdul, he’s full of s----,” the president said. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump-backed John James wins Michigan’s GOP primary for governor
headlines.description: Rep. John James has won Michigan’s Republican nomination for governor, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Iran Hormuz Deal Advances Amid US Munitions Supply Questions
headlines.description: A deal on the Strait of Hormuz could come as early as Thursday, with the Iranian foreign ministry saying a draft agreement between Iran and Oman is under review. It comes as there are new concerns over a potential shortage of U.S. weaponry. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Blogger Perez Hilton receiving medical care after appearing to self-harm online
headlines.description: Perez Hilton is “receiving medical care” Wednesday, the celebrity blogger and podcaster’s team and family said, after police responded to his Miami-area home following reports that he appeared to engage in self-harm during a livestream.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Senators vote to hold Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress for pleading the Fifth
headlines.description: Fauci declined to answer senators’ questions over 100 times during last week’s hearing, angering Republican lawmakers who have targeted him for years.

headlines.title: Firefighters are working 16-hour shifts as they battle the Spokane Complex Fire
headlines.description: The Old Trails and Autumn Lane fires were each 13% contained Wednesday, and the Fairview fire was 5% contained, according to fire officials.
